Enabling Blockchain Innovations with Pegged Sidechains [Whitepaper PDF]

Sidechains are a new innovation currently in development. The plan is essentially to create alt coins with various attributes and peg them to bitcoin in a way that they are easily convertible. This will allow for substantial innovation to occur on sidechains without necessarily risking the bitcoin blockchain. Some sidechains will provide functionality that bitcoin doesn't currently offer, such as faster confirmation times and improved privacy features. This really opens up a slew of very exciting possibilities moving forward.
